patterns: APPSC asks scheme-to-purpose and scheme-to-amount one-liners: Amma Vodi/Talliki Vandanam Rs 15,000 to mothers, Rythu Bharosa Rs 13,500 incl. Rs 6,000 PM-KISAN, Cheyutha Rs 75,000 over 4 years for women 45-60, Aasara = SHG loans outstanding on 11 April 2019.
Launch dates are asked directly (Rythu Bharosa Oct 2019, Jagananna houses 3 June 2021, P4 on Ugadi 30 March 2025); pension step-ups (Rs 2,250 to Rs 2,500, Jan 2022).
'Which is NOT part of Navaratnalu' and old-name/new-name pairs are recurring traps; NTR Vaidya Seva Rs 25 lakh cover (May 2025) keyed.
App MCQs track current Super Six schemes well; a few add budget/beneficiary figures and fiscal-debate items beyond PYQ depth.
